title: Solar latitude and longitude from space (SunPy)
description: SunPy transforms a synthetic solar coordinate grid to three observer latitudes. Curves show actual heliographic-to-helioprojective transforms, not telescope images.
description_ko: SunPy로 태양 좌표 격자를 세 관측 위도에서의 좌표로 변환했어요. 망원경 사진이 아닌 실제 태양 좌표 변환 결과예요.
prompt: Solar latitude and longitude from space. Rerun the included recipe to change simulation inputs.
made_with: sunpy==8.0.0, numpy==2.2.6; executed locally on macOS arm64
